description: Turn the optional weekly executive digest email on or off and choose its delivery day, hour (in the workspace time zone) and sections (Studio and Pro, admins and owners).

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

dayOfWeek.description: Day of the week in the workspace time zone: 0 (Sunday) through 6 (Saturday). Defaults to 1 (Monday).

enabled.description: true to turn on the weekly executive digest email; false to turn it off.

hour.description: Hour of the day in the workspace time zone (0 to 23). Defaults to 9 (9:00 AM).

includeAttention.description: Include accounts needing reconnect and recent failed posts (default true).

includeInbox.description: Include open comments and Google reviews counts (default true).

includeResults.description: Include 7-day engagement, top post and follower growth (default true).

language.description: Email language: "auto" (follows brand language, default), "en" (English), or "es" (formal Spanish).

name: digest_settings_set
title: Configure weekly digest email
